subject: using rstan to get unconstrained parameters from model fitted with cmdstan?

messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: using rstan to get unconstrained parameters from model fitted with cmdstan?
parts:
Hi,

I would like to use rstan to get parameters in the unconstrained
space from a model I fitted in cmdstan.

I think this should be doable, but I am not sure if what I am doing
is OK.

So far I have taken following approach (in R after the model was
fit with cmdstan):
1) create the stan_model from the model file
2) run the model for one iteration to get a stanfit object sf_R
3) create a stanfit object sf_C from the samples.csv file 
   created with cmdstan (using read_stan_csv)
4) copy the samples by setting sf_R@sim = sf_C@sim

My questions: 
a) Is if it is safe to now use sf_R to get unconstrained parameters.
b) How can I easily access the names of the constrained parameters?
    I found the method num_pars_unconstrained, but can't get it to work.

Thanks in advance!

Best - Guido

PS: rstan suggests to use the pairs method to investigate problems 
with divergent iterations. I think it should be pointed out that one should
always look at parameters in the unconstrained space, and that one should 
better not use pairs if one has more than a few parameters.
